## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The parser now requires the exact `REPORT v1` header. The production change looks correct, but one added test does not exercise the behavior it claims to protect.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
(none)

## Suggestions
- tests/test_report.py:12 — tests — `test_rejects_legacy_header` constructs `REPORT v1\nversion=v0` without an `END` terminator, so parsing returns before header validation. — This test passes even if version validation is removed; use a complete report with an unsupported header.

## Strengths
- The complete-report regression test exercises rejection of `REPORT v0`, while the existing test verifies acceptance of `REPORT v1`.

## Not reviewed
- Tests were read but not executed, as required by the review instructions.
